section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1999
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1999 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 1.3.8.3 Tamil Nadu, which shared the maximum(15.7%) of Road Accident in the country also reported the maximum number of Road Accidents during each month of the year. Delhi UT among UTs reported the maximum number of 'Road Accidents' to the tune of 3.2% at national level.
